executedChecks: python3 -m unittest tests.test_git_runtime -v: 14 tests, 13 passed and ELOOP regression failed before fix
finalReport: The symlink regression is corrected: test_tamper_and_lock passes. test_recovery_does_not_adopt_unsealed_foreign_directory also passes and confirms recovery adds no files to an unrelated destination. In the previous complete suite execution the other 13 tests passed, including atomic publication, crash recovery, orphan-child lock retention and source immutability. No other reproducible defects found within the reviewed scope. The complete suite was not rerun by the reviewer after the exception-translation fix.

findings.problem: Process death after destination mkdir and before ownership records strands the run.
findings.resolution: Seal records before native atomic exclusive directory publication; retain child-held coordinator lock.

findings.problem: O_NOFOLLOW ELOOP leaked OSError from recovery instead of the documented runtime rejection.
findings.resolution: Translate ELOOP to InvalidGitRuntime and reject unsealed foreign directories before any writes.

limits: Software/code review only. Does not establish independent scientific validation, Linux host reproduction, founder approval, ADR adoption or full M4 closure.
